messages:
Priya (CS): heads-up — AcmeHealth onboarding hitting intermittent 429s during SDK init in eu-west. It only happens when their Cloud Functions warmup runs and fires 8 parallel preflight requests.

Priya (CS): attaching short log excerpt they pasted:
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z INFO preflight token_ok key=acct-234 ttl=2s
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z WARN preflight rate_limit_exceeded key=acct-234 limit=100 window=60 remaining=0
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z INFO request dropped route=/v1/chat reason=rate_limit
```

Maya (Support): thanks — do they use ephemeral tokens for each function instance or share one token across warmups?

acme_infra: they spawn new instances quickly. each instance requests its own ephemeral short-lived token from our edge helper lib (node). we assumed reuse but warmup code requests a fresh token per init.

Jorge (Eng): that pattern can cause token fanout on preflight. our per-key concurrent preflight window can be tripped if many back-to-back fresh tokens map to same rate bucket.

Jorge (Eng): quick checks: can you grab a sample request/res header dump (include x-rate-limit-* and x-rwi if present)? Also confirm Authorization header format and whether tokens are minted with identical scopes.

Priya (CS): sent headers from one failed init to the ticket:
```
Authorization: Bearer eph_abc123
x-region: eu-west-1
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-reset: 24
```

Maya (Support): reset looks like seconds until reset — they're hitting 0. suggests many preflights in same second window.

Jorge (Eng): mitigation options:
- stagger warmup calls with jitter (recommended)
- reuse a single preflight token across instance warmups for ~30s
- add client-side leaky-bucket (limit concurrent preflights to 2)
- server-side: we can temporarily increase their soft window for onboarding (CS ticket)

Jorge (Eng): quick repro curl to simulate their warmup pattern (run in background 8x):
```
for i in {1..8}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer eph_TEST" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight & done
```

acme_infra: ok we can patch warmup to reuse token and add random 0-250ms jitter between starts.

Priya (CS): OnboardBot created ticket CS-1287 and flagged DedicatedRouting for temporary bump.

OnboardBot: ticket CS-1287 created — priority=P2, owner=@Jorge (Eng), due=2026-03-22

Jorge (Eng): I'll scope a short-lived change on our side to relax the preflight concurrency throttle for their acct for 48h while they finish rollout. Also will PR a docs snippet for SDK warmup best-practices.

Priya (CS): perfect. Priya to follow up with AcmeHealth tomorrow morning EU time and confirm warmup change.

Maya (Support): logging note for SEs: look for x-rate-limit-remaining==0 on preflight and Authorization header patterns to differentiate token-fanout vs single token saturation.

acme_infra: patched warmup, rolling to staging now. will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:

Priya (CS): thanks team — marking action items in CS ticket and closing loop after staging verification.
